patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I threw up something that looked like coffee grounds, and my stools have been black and tarry. I get lightheaded when I stand. I drink a fair bit, and I take ibuprofen for my knees.
presentation.triageNote: 55-year-old male with coffee-ground vomit, black tarry stools, and lightheadedness when standing. Heart rate is 108 and blood pressure is 104/64; he regularly uses ibuprofen and drinks alcohol.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because coffee-ground emesis, melena, orthostatic lightheadedness, tachycardia, and borderline blood pressure indicate a high-risk gastrointestinal bleed.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has evidence of upper gastrointestinal bleeding with early physiologic compromise.
clinical.acuityReason: Coffee-ground emesis and melena establish gastrointestinal blood loss, while orthostatic symptoms, heart rate 108, and blood pressure 104/64 raise concern for ongoing volume loss.
expectedResources: Two large-bore IVs and fluid or blood support as indicated
CBC, coagulation studies, metabolic testing, and type and crossmatch
teachingPoints: Dark tarry stool and coffee-ground emesis localize bleeding to the upper gastrointestinal tract.
A single blood-pressure value may underestimate blood loss early in the course.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Resuscitative assessment, laboratory testing, medication, and urgent endoscopy would likely be followed by monitored admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, one hand resting on his stomach, looks weak
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 55-year-old man, pale and drained, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, one hand resting on his stomach, looking weak. Expression: pale, washed-out, and tired. Clearly visible: a pale, drained face and a hand resting on the stomach. No text, no logos.
